displayName: Research a prospect before a meeting
summary: Get a full brief on anyone you're about to meet.

useCases.title: Research a prospect before a meeting
useCases.message: I have a meeting coming up. Ask me who I'm meeting and the meeting context. Then go find everything you can: their LinkedIn, company news, recent posts, and any emails we've exchanged. Give me a tight brief covering recent news, what they likely care about, and any angles worth mentioning.
